In plain English

Overnight the euro slipped from 1.09748 to 1.09575 and is now back on today's open price, 1.09609. Just under the Asia low there is a 4-hour zone where buyers stepped in before.

London often opens with one push lower to trigger the stops under the Asia low, then turns. We wait for a 5-minute candle to close back above 1.09575. If the euro closes a 15-minute candle below 1.09540 instead, we stand aside. It is a US holiday, so moves may be small and slow.
